text:
Anna M: Morning team — quick async standup for the campaign launch

Anna M: What I did: finalized the content calendar for launch week (docs link: https://redwood.ai/launch-calendar). Uploaded hero graphics to the assets folder.
Anna M: Blockers: need copy sign-off for the benchmark post from product (Sam), and a short QA pass on image alt text from design (Riley).
Anna M: Today: coordinate final publishing schedule, confirm bench timing, loop in growth on distribution.

Sam P: Got the benchmark PR open — need a quick review on the intro paragraph tone. Pinged in #docs.
Sam P: I can sign off on copy by 2pm PT if no major edits.

Devon E: FYI — infra will throttle scheduled posts if we exceed 5 concurrent API publish jobs. Can we stagger by 5m?
Devon E: Also, small fix pushed to the embedder that improves thumbnail ordering.

Maria G: Growth will run an initial audience test at 1k recipients for the first benchmark post. If CTR >= 3% we'll scale.
Maria G: @Anna M can we get the tracking params by EOD?

Riley C: Reviewed hero images, fixed alt text on two assets. Left comments on the copy where call-to-action could be stronger.
Riley C: Will QA publish on staging at 11:30am PT.

Anna M: Thanks all. @Sam P — sounds good for 2pm. @Devon E — staggering by 5m works, I'll update the schedule. @Maria G I'll add tracking params by 5pm.

deploy-bot: Scheduled post job created: job_id=px-8871, scheduled_at=2025-06-05T15:00:00Z :white_check_mark:

Sam P: Quick ask — can someone glance at the benchmark metrics table? small calc on sample size.
Devon E: I'll take it after staging QA.

Anna M: Blocker cleared: legal okayed the benchmark methodology.
Anna M: Any last blockers before I lock the calendar?

Maria G: None from growth.
Riley C: All good from design.
Sam P: None.
Devon E: Rolling.

Anna M: Locking calendar at 5pm PT. Thanks everyone :rocket:
